title: Kaneki Harness — Agent-Agnostic Architecture (v0.1.0)
description: Four layers of the Kaneki SDLC harness: swappable AI hosts and UI, orchestration and host/model resolution, safety gates and shipping, and the pure data kernel.

lanes.label: Agent hosts and UI · pluggable adapters
Data kernel · no host or project hardcoding

nodes.label: Developer
nodes.detail: Answers ASK_USER prompts and closes user-boundary nodes (fix-plan, feature-plan, scope, deliverable-ready, triage-review, respond-review) with --actor user

nodes.label: Interactive host
nodes.detail: hosts/antigravity (default), claude, opencode: dispatchMode native · cursor: manual. Runs the composed preamble + playbooks as the controller.

nodes.label: Headless CLIs
nodes.detail: hosts/codex, gemini, generic: dispatchMode subprocess. Launched by sdlc dispatch with argv from build_argv() (no shell=True).

nodes.label: install.py
nodes.detail: sdlc install --host antigravity|claude|codex|gemini|cursor|opencode|generic [--dry-run] [--force] [--with-my-git]. Writes .sdlc/bin/sdlc (LF, 0o755), .sdlc/.harness-home, host.local.json and a SHA-256 manifest <hostRoot>/kaneki-harness.json (keeps user edits).

nodes.label: Board and app
nodes.detail: web.py: read-only HTTP on 127.0.0.1 serving web_page.html. board.py builds STATUS.md, ticket-detail and gate-request JSON for the desktop app (contract.py CONTRACT_VERSION = 1).

nodes.label: Git remote
nodes.detail: Delivery adapters github-pr, gitlab-mr, manual. PR comments come back through sdlc review-fetch.

nodes.label: Playbooks
nodes.detail: playbooks/flow.md, onboarding.md, ship.md, packet-template.md, roles/{light,routine,deep}.md, nodes/ (20 host-neutral node cards). Intents: DRIVER_CALL, DISPATCH_UNIT, RESUME_UNIT, ASK_USER, INSPECT_CODE / RUN_CHECK.

nodes.label: sdlc driver
nodes.detail: harness/cli.py: fail-closed JSON CLI, 32 subcommands (init, lane, status, plan, packet, dispatch, record, gate, worktree, git, ship-request, ship, ship-record, onboard-*, install, host, web …). HarnessError → exit 2.

nodes.label: dispatch.py
nodes.detail: sdlc dispatch --ticket T --node N --unit U: builds the packet, runs codex / claude / gemini / opencode / --command, saves logs/<dispatchId>.dispatch.log, extracts tokens + verdict, fails closed without a result file (G7), then record_unit().

nodes.label: Host resolver
nodes.detail: resolve_execution(): graph tier → profile nodeOverrides → local host binding. Host precedence: --host > $SDLC_HOST > host.local.json > profile. model_matches(): strict | alias-match | inherit-ok.

nodes.label: onboard.py
nodes.detail: onboard-scan detects repos, stacks, surfaces, CI commands, trackers, DBs, git identities (+ q-host question); onboard-verify runs safe checks; onboard-write writes the profile, evidence sidecar, stack adapters, host.local.json and .gitignore.

nodes.label: Gates G0–G7
nodes.detail: sdlc gate: section parsers, citations, locale checks, commit_message() CM003–CM016, rulepack filtering by phase. G0 boundary · G1 analysis doubt · G3 options · G4 loop cap (default 2) · G5 ambiguity · G6 shared state · G7 missing prerequisite.

nodes.label: Ticket ledger
nodes.detail: .sdlc/tickets/<ID>/: state.json, append-only hash-chained decisions.jsonl, receipts, file locks, STATUS.md, logs/. usage.py keeps the per-round token ledger.

nodes.label: Git guards
nodes.detail: worktree_hooks.py installs scoped .sdlc/hooks/{pre-commit,pre-push} (extensions.worktreeConfig); gitpolicy.py blocks history / identity mutations in sdlc git; gitid.py pins git.user + SSH command.

nodes.label: Ship approval
nodes.detail: sdlc ship-request builds a deterministic preview + requestDigest; the user approves that exact digest; approvals.py writes a short-lived lease in .sdlc/ship-approvals.json (checkout + head).

nodes.label: ship.py
nodes.detail: native-git (default): commit as git.user, push via pinned SSH / gh, open PR via gh / glab / manual. my-git (opt-in, install --with-my-git): emits /my-git:commit, push, pr; sdlc ship-record then verifies and records.

nodes.label: lifecycle.json
nodes.detail: graph/lifecycle.json + graph.py: 23 nodes, layers analysis / implementation / delivery / after-pr, lanes full and lite, @slot extension points, gates G0–G7, token-based invalidation of dependents.

nodes.label: 11 schemas
nodes.detail: Draft 2020-12 subset validated by stdlib schema.py: project-profile, host-binding, state, decision-event, graph, adapter, rulepack, extension, facts, profile-evidence, onboarding-candidates.

nodes.label: Adapters
nodes.detail: adapters/: tracker 4 (github-issues, jira, backlog, local-file), stack 4 (node-ts, python, php-laravel, flutter-dart), surface 6, delivery 3. rulepacks/core.json + stack packs, templates/.

nodes.label: host.local.json
nodes.detail: .sdlc/host.local.json (git-ignored): host, dispatchMode native | subprocess | manual, tiers.{light,routine,deep} {model, effort, contextWindow, aliases}, enforcement, cross-host nodeOverrides. Presets: hosts/<host>/tiers.json.

nodes.label: sdlc.profile.json
nodes.detail: Checked in: tracker, stacks, surfaces, delivery + shipBackend, rulepacks, families, locale, git.user, gates.loopCap, portable nodeOverrides. Evidence in sdlc.profile.evidence.json.

cards.title: Hosts and install · swappable AI host
items: Interactive host — antigravity (default, flash_lite / flash / pro), claude (haiku / sonnet / opus), opencode: native dispatch; cursor: manual, inherit-ok
Headless CLIs — codex (strict, gpt-5.2-codex), gemini (strict, gemini-2.5-*), generic (inherit-ok): subprocess dispatch via sdlc dispatch
install.py — prepends hosts/<host>/preamble.md to the canonical playbooks; SHA-256 manifest keeps your edits on re-install; --with-my-git is opt-in
Board and app — web.py on 127.0.0.1 plus read-only app contract commands: tickets, status-of, ticket-detail, gate-request, contract

cards.title: Orchestration · one workflow for every host
items: Playbooks — 5 intents (DRIVER_CALL, DISPATCH_UNIT, RESUME_UNIT, ASK_USER, INSPECT_CODE / RUN_CHECK) mapped to host tools by the preamble
sdlc driver — cli.py, 32 fail-closed JSON subcommands; packet inlines roles/{light,routine,deep}.md and warns above 25% of the tier contextWindow
Host resolver — tier from graph → profile nodeOverrides (+ escalateAfter) → host binding; --host > $SDLC_HOST > host.local.json > profile
dispatch.py — runs external CLIs, logs logs/<dispatchId>.dispatch.log, extracts tokens + verdict, G7 on a missing result file

cards.title: Safety and ship · work nodes never commit
items: Gates G0–G7 — G0 boundary, G1 analysis doubt, G3 options / shared flow, G4 NEEDS CHANGES after loopCap 2, G5 ambiguity, G6 shared state / device, G7 missing prerequisite (exit 2)
Ticket ledger — state.json + hash-chained decisions.jsonl + receipts under ticket locks
Git guards — scoped worktree hooks, gitpolicy.py blocks history / identity mutations, gitid.py pins git.user + SSH
Ship approval → ship.py — user approves the exact requestDigest; native-git (default) or my-git backend; ship-record verifies the commit

cards.title: Data kernel · the project is data
items: lifecycle.json — full lane (prepare → bug or feature analysis → coding → staged code-review → testcase → evidence → final-review → delivery) and lite lane (scope → change → check → drafts); promote with sdlc lane --set full
Two axes — sdlc.profile.json (team-shared project data) and .sdlc/host.local.json (git-ignored host binding) compose at runtime in cli.py
11 schemas, 17 adapters, rulepacks — validated by stdlib schema.py; Python 3.9+, no dependencies, 24 modules, 147 tests
